objectives.label: Open in the evening
objectives.descriptorEN: Open in the evening register with 'Dober večer!'

objectives.label: Ask a recommendation
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for a recommendation with 'Kaj priporočate za ___?' (formal vi).

objectives.label: Choose a course
objectives.descriptorEN: Choose a course with 'Vzel bom ___' in the accusative.

objectives.label: Order across courses
objectives.descriptorEN: Order a starter then a main (predjed → glavna jed).

objectives.label: Compliment & toast
objectives.descriptorEN: Compliment with 'Postrežba je odlična!' and toast 'Na tebe!'

d1.speaker: npc
d1.sl: Dober večer, dobrodošli! Miza za dva?
d1.en: Good evening, welcome! A table for two?
d1.deliverySL: [warmly] Dober večer, dobrodošli! Miza za dva?

e1a.speaker: client
e1a.sl: Dober večer, ja, mizo ob oknu, prosim.
e1a.en: Good evening, yes, a table by the window, please.

e1b.speaker: client
e1b.sl: Dober večer, imamo rezervacijo na ime Slavko. Lep lokal imate.
e1b.en: Good evening, we have a reservation under the name Slavko. You have a lovely place.

d2.speaker: npc
d2.sl: Izvolite meni. Bi najprej kaj za piti?
d2.en: Here's the menu. Would you like something to drink first?
d2.deliverySL: [warmly] Izvolite meni. Bi najprej kaj za piti?

e2a.speaker: client
e2a.en: A glass of red wine, please.

e2b.speaker: client
e2b.en: Just water for now, thank you.

d3.speaker: npc
d3.sl: Ste že izbrali predjed, ali vam kaj priporočim?
d3.en: Have you already chosen a starter, or shall I recommend something?
d3.deliverySL: [warmly] Ste že izbrali predjed, ali vam kaj priporočim?

e3a.speaker: client
e3a.en: What do you recommend for a starter?

d4.speaker: npc
d4.sl: Priporočam carpaccio ali juho dneva — oboje je odlično.
d4.en: I recommend the carpaccio or the soup of the day — both are excellent.
d4.deliverySL: [warmly] Priporočam carpaccio ali juho dneva — oboje je odlično.

d5.speaker: npc
d5.sl: Odlična izbira. In za glavno jed?
d5.en: Excellent choice. And for the main course?
d5.deliverySL: [warmly] Odlična izbira. In za glavno jed?

e5a.speaker: client
e5a.en: What do you recommend as a main course?

e5b.speaker: client
e5b.en: I already know — I'll take the fish.

d6.speaker: npc
d6.sl: Brancin ali goveji file — oboje je izvrstno.
d6.en: The sea bass or the beef fillet — both are excellent.
d6.deliverySL: [warmly] Brancin ali goveji file — oboje je izvrstno.

d7.speaker: npc
d7.sl: Odlično. Bi k glavni jedi kaj za piti? Imamo odličen domači rdeči.
d7.en: Excellent. Something to drink with the main? We have an excellent local red.
d7.deliverySL: [warmly] Odlično. Bi k glavni jedi kaj za piti? Imamo odličen domači rdeči.

e7a.speaker: client
e7a.en: Yes, a glass of the local red, please.

e7b.speaker: client
e7b.sl: Voda je čisto v redu, hvala.

d8.speaker: npc
d8.sl: Takoj prinesem. Uživajte v večeru. Izvolite predjed.
d8.en: Coming right up. Enjoy your evening. Here's your starter.
d8.deliverySL: [warmly] Takoj prinesem. Uživajte v večeru. Izvolite predjed.

d9.speaker: npc
d9.en: Here is your main course. Enjoy your meal!

d10.speaker: npc
d10.sl: Zelo me veseli. Bi vas zamikala še sladica? Imamo čokoladno torto ali panna cotta.
d10.en: So glad. Could I tempt you with dessert? We have chocolate cake or panna cotta.
d10.deliverySL: [warmly] Zelo me veseli. Bi vas zamikala še sladica? Imamo čokoladno torto ali panna cotta.

e10a.speaker: client
e10a.en: I'll take the chocolate cake, please.

d11.speaker: npc
d11.en: Excellent. Are you celebrating something special?

e11a.speaker: client
e11a.en: Yes, my friend has a birthday.

e11b.speaker: client
e11b.en: No, just a lovely evening out.

d12.speaker: npc
d12.sl: Želite še kaj, ali vam prinesem račun?
d12.en: Would you like anything else, or shall I bring the bill?
d12.deliverySL: [warmly] Želite še kaj, ali vam prinesem račun?

d12toast.speaker: npc
d12toast.sl: Rojstni dan! Sladica je na račun hiše. Prinesem nekaj za nazdraviti.
d12toast.en: A birthday! The dessert's on the house. Let me bring something to toast with.
d12toast.deliverySL: [warmly] Rojstni dan! Sladica je na račun hiše. Prinesem nekaj za nazdraviti.

d12b.speaker: npc
d12b.sl: Na zdravje! Naj vam zdaj prinesem račun?
d12b.en: Cheers! Now, shall I bring you the bill?
d12b.deliverySL: [warmly] Na zdravje! Naj vam zdaj prinesem račun?

d13.speaker: npc
d13.sl: Izvolite račun. S kartico seveda lahko. Skupaj je oseminsedemdeset evrov.
d13.en: Here's the bill. By card is of course fine. That's seventy-eight euros in total.
d13.deliverySL: [warmly] Izvolite račun. S kartico seveda lahko. Skupaj je oseminsedemdeset evrov.

d14.speaker: npc
d14.sl: Hvala, ker ste nas obiskali. Želim vam čudovit večer!
d14.en: Thank you for coming. I wish you a wonderful evening!
d14.deliverySL: [warmly] Hvala, ker ste nas obiskali. Želim vam čudovit večer!

e14a.speaker: client
e14a.en: Thank you for a wonderful evening.
